title: Occupations of new Amsterdam burghers, 1531-1607
descriptions: In this dataset the number of new burghers in Amsterdam, divided over several periods is entered. Also the occupation codes and occupation titles, based on the Leiden census of 1889 are included as well as the occupation codes of the classification system of Van Dillen.
